import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('or_weekly_reportable_diseases.csv')
week_df = df[(df['FirstDateOfWeek'] == '2020-11-15') & (df['LastDateOfWeek'] == '2020-11-21')]
gonorrhea_cases = week_df[week_df['Disease'] == 'Gonorrhea']['Cases'].sum()
salmonellosis_cases = week_df[week_df['Disease'] == 'Salmonellosis']['Cases'].sum()
result = 'Gonorrhea' if gonorrhea_cases > salmonellosis_cases else 'Salmonellosis'
